title: The same bill again (variant A: November already paid)

decisions.summary: I did nothing this wake. The new Stockline invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 240.00) is already paid according to the ledger (transfer sim-licence-nov), so I didn't plan it again. No agent is blocked by its mandate and nothing is waiting for the CFO. I didn't sweep the 0.80 of net earnings because no agent has spent anything yet, so the money the other mandates may still spend would likely use all of it.
